title: World Cup 2026 Groups
description: Which teams are in which group? Test your knowledge of the 2026 World Cup draw.

questions.q: Mexico are in Group A of the 2026 World Cup. Which other team joins them alongside Czechia and South Africa?
questions.explain: Group A features Mexico, South Africa, Czechia and South Korea — a balanced group with the North American co-host, an African qualifier, a Central European side and an Asian powerhouse.

questions.q: Canada, as a co-host nation, are in Group B. Which European dark horse joins them alongside Bosnia and Qatar?
questions.explain: Group B contains Canada, Switzerland, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Qatar — featuring the co-host Canada, a consistently tricky Swiss outfit, Edin Džeko's Bosnia in their second World Cup, and hosts-turned-qualifiers Qatar.

questions.q: Group C is one of the toughest. Brazil, Morocco and Scotland are in it — who is the fourth team?
questions.explain: Group C features Brazil, Morocco, Scotland and Haiti — a fascinating mix of a football giant, the 2022 semi-finalists, Scotland returning after 28 years, and Haiti making their second World Cup appearance.

questions.q: The USA, as a co-host, are in Group D. Which team joins them alongside Australia and Paraguay?
questions.explain: Group D features the USA, Turkey, Australia and Paraguay — all teams with points to prove. The USA are on home soil; Turkey return after a 24-year absence; Australia are consistent AFC qualifiers; Paraguay end a 16-year wait.

questions.q: Germany headline Group E. Which African nation joins them alongside Ecuador and Curaçao?
questions.explain: Group E contains Germany, Ecuador, Ivory Coast (Côte d'Ivoire) and Curaçao. Germany look to bounce back after 2022's group exit; Ivory Coast bring African Cup of Nations form; Ecuador have real pace up front; and Curaçao make their historic debut.

questions.q: The Netherlands, Japan and Sweden are all in Group F. Which African team completes the group?
questions.explain: Group F features the Netherlands, Japan, Sweden and Tunisia — a competitive group. The Dutch aim for their fourth final; Japan arrive as 2022 giant-killers; Sweden return after a 2022 absence; Tunisia make their sixth World Cup appearance.

questions.q: Belgium headline Group G alongside Iran, Egypt and which Oceania debutant?
questions.explain: Group G features Belgium, Iran, Egypt and New Zealand — the latter returning after 16 years. Belgium's golden generation has one last chance at glory; Iran meet their familiar rivals; Egypt and Salah finally return after 20 years.

questions.q: Group H features Spain and Uruguay — two World Cup powerhouses. Who are the other two teams?
questions.explain: Group H contains Spain, Uruguay, Saudi Arabia and Cape Verde (Cabo Verde). Spain are defending European champions; Uruguay bring CONMEBOL quality; Saudi Arabia arrive after shocking Argentina in 2022; and Cabo Verde make their historic debut.

questions.q: France, featuring Mbappé, are in Group I. Which fellow 2022 World Cup quarter-finalist is also in their group?
questions.explain: Group I features France, Senegal, Norway and Iraq. France are defending runner-up; Senegal bring AFCON quality; Norway arrive with Haaland for their first WC since 1998; Iraq make only their second World Cup appearance.

questions.q: Argentina, as defending World Cup champions, are in Group J. Which European nation are they alongside alongside Algeria and Jordan?
questions.explain: Group J contains Argentina, Austria, Algeria and Jordan — with the world champions facing an Austrian revival, Algeria's consistent North African quality, and Jordan making their historic debut.

questions.q: Portugal, Colombia and DR Congo are in Group K. Which Central Asian nation making their debut joins them?
questions.explain: Group K features Portugal, Colombia, DR Congo and Uzbekistan. Portugal look strong; Colombia bring James and Caicedo; DR Congo return after 52 years as Zaire; and Uzbekistan make Central Asian football history with their debut.

questions.q: Group L is dubbed by some as the 'Group of Death' — which four teams are in it?
questions.explain: Group L contains England, Croatia, Ghana and Panama — recreating past World Cup encounters. England face their 2018 semi-final opponents Croatia again; Ghana aim to avenge the 2010 Suárez handball exit; and Panama play their second World Cup.
